pages.description: A green caterpillar stretches across the cover. Its bright red head has purple feelers and little green eyes. Look at the different shades of green along its body.
A small orange sun sits above rows of colorful circles. Reds, blues, yellows, and greens fill the lower part of the picture.
Colorful circles crowd together along the bottom of this opening page. Some are bright, and some are dark. Notice how each circle looks a little different.
A tiny pale egg rests on a broad green leaf. The scene is dark, with deep blue and black shapes around it. Look closely to find the egg.
A pale moon glows against the dark blue sky. Its round shape stands out among the darker colors.
A little caterpillar appears near the ground. Orange rays reach into the picture from the edge of the page. The caterpillar looks very small beside them.
A huge orange sun fills the picture. Long red and yellow rays reach outward. Its face has two small eyes and a gentle smile.
The small caterpillar travels beneath the smiling sun. Compare its tiny body with the enormous circle overhead.
A row of colorful fruit crosses the page. A round hole marks the red apple at the left. Look for the caterpillar near the fruit.
The apple and caterpillar appear beside part of the smiling sun. The page edge changes the picture, bringing the fruit into view.
Two green pears stand together at the front of the row. Each has a round hole. Their shapes are wider at the bottom and narrower at the top.
The two pears appear beside the orange sun. The caterpillar rests near them. Notice the green leaves above the pears.
Three purple plums stand in a row. Their green leaves point in different directions. Three round holes show through the fruit.
The purple plums fill more of the page. The small caterpillar is near the last plum. Count the three purple shapes.
Four red strawberries sit beside one another. Each has a green leafy top and a round hole. Look at the tiny dark marks on their red surfaces.
The caterpillar curves around the last of four strawberries. Their green tops tilt in different directions. Follow the row from left to right.
Five orange fruits stretch across the page. Each has a round hole. Their orange surfaces contain red and yellow patches.
A row of snacks fills the picture: cake, an ice cream cone, a pickle, cheese, and salami. Each shape has different colors and textures.
More treats continue across the next page: a lollipop, a slice of pie, a sausage, a cupcake, and watermelon. The little caterpillar sits below them.
A broad green leaf fills the picture. Several round holes run across it. Dark lines and lighter patches make the leaf look textured.
The caterpillar rests on a long green stem beside a brown tree trunk. The trunk has dark streaks, and the stem stretches across the page.
A much larger caterpillar fills the picture. Its body is made of many rounded green sections. Its red head and purple feelers stand out at one end.
A brown cocoon hangs from a branch. Its curved shape has red and dark brown patches. Look at the different stripes across its surface.
Part of a butterfly wing opens into view. Blue, green, yellow, and red shapes decorate the wing. A bright red spot sits near the top.
A butterfly spreads its colorful wings. Its slim body sits between them, with long feelers reaching upward. Explore the many colors and patterns on both wings.
On the back cover, a small caterpillar rests on a huge green leaf beneath an orange sun. This closes our picture tour.
